# Aggregate {#sec-aggregate}

*This section covers* the core object — a compound distribution, frequency ×
severity via FFT. It is the heart of the library, so it gets several recipes:

- **@sec-aggregate-discrete** — a fully discrete aggregate (the `Dice` idiom);
  exact, no discretization error, the cleanest place to trust the machinery.
- **@sec-aggregate-insurance** — a realistically-calibrated insurance book (the
  house book); the `show` flow you reuse everywhere.
- **@sec-aggregate-mixed-severity** — mixed / multi-component severities.
- **@sec-aggregate-limit-profile** — an exposure/limit profile (several limits
  with weights), the bread-and-butter of commercial rating.
- **@sec-aggregate-pricing** — put a distortion on the aggregate to get a price.
